Vehicle tool kit: - Usually located in the luggage compartment or underfloor storage.
- May include wheel bolt adapter, screwdriver, towing eye, and jack.
- Only use tools that are in good condition and approved for the vehicle.
Changing the windscreen wiper blades: - Raise the wiper arm away from the windshield.
- Press the release tab to remove the old blade.
- Slide the new blade into position until it clicks.
- Ensure the blade is securely attached before lowering the arm.
Jump start: - Only use jump cables with sufficient cross-section.
- Connect the positive cable to the discharged and donor battery terminals.
- Connect the negative cable to a metal ground point away from the battery.
- Start the donor vehicle first, then the discharged one.
- Do not allow the cables to touch moving parts.
Towing the vehicle: - Use the designated towing eye stored with the tool kit.
- Screw it firmly into the threaded mount in the bumper.
- Tow slowly and avoid jerky movements.
- Steering and braking require more effort when towed without engine power.
- Do not tow with a rope if the distance is too long or legally restricted.
Fuses: - Fuses protect electrical systems from overcurrent.
- Fuse boxes are located in the cabin and luggage compartment.
- Replace fuses only with those of the same rating.
- If a new fuse blows immediately, contact a service center.
- Use the fuse diagram for correct identification.
Changing bulbs: - Switch off ignition and lights before replacing bulbs.
- Avoid touching the glass part of halogen bulbs with bare hands.
- Access may require removing covers or panels.
- Use only approved bulbs with correct specification.
- If unsure, contact a service partner for assistance.
